segments.text: Ok so this is the Agent Read-Only Context page for Google Antigravity with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, this connect agent context call should send the user's name and timezone to the agent.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. I asked the agent who I am and which record is selected, it should know from the app context, but it never answers, there's no reply at all.
So basically, the context never reaches the agent.
Antigravity needs the app context option and an instruction to read it, that's never shown, and umm, the backend log says the model gave invalid output.
So yeah, this is the issue, kindly fix it.
